committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects rural hospitals, critical access hospitals, rural emergency hospitals, maternal health practitioners, and patients in rural areas experiencing maternity care shortages.
dimensions.evidence: rural health care facilities without dedicated obstetric units

dimensions.assessment: Substantially expands access to emergency training, equipment purchases, telehealth consultations, and collaborative care models for rural facilities lacking specialized obstetric services.
dimensions.evidence: purchase equipment necessary to manage obstetric emergencies

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes specific appropriations including $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2028 through 2032 for medical emergency training, $17,300,000 annually for emergency support services, and minimum grant allocations.
dimensions.evidence: and $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2028 through 2032 before the period at the end

dimensions.assessment: Modifies multiple sections of the Public Health Service Act to expand HRSA grant programs, telehealth networks, ECHO programs, and mandatory federal reporting studies.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall award a total of not less than $2,000,000 per fiscal year in grants or cooperative agreements

dimensions.assessment: Extends funding authorizations and program activities through fiscal year 2032 alongside permanent statutory program modifications.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2028 through 2032

missing_information: Total aggregate multi-year federal cost estimates across all amended sections beyond the explicitly listed fiscal year authorizations.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Public Health Service Act to create, expand, and fund grant programs, training initiatives, telehealth networks, and studies aimed at improving emergency obstetric care in rural areas without dedicated maternity units.
